Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250402. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, non-null pChEMBL value, and target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1250402. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
